name: parallax
title: Parallax
description: A container whose background image scrolls slower than the page.
improvements: Uses CSS scroll-driven animations (ViewTimeline) when supported, so the effect runs off the main thread with no scroll listener.
The fallback scroll handler is passive and only attached while the container is on screen (IntersectionObserver).
Turned off when the user prefers reduced motion, with the image centered.
No fixed image height assumptions: the image covers the container at any size, and children render on top.
